projects.title: Prishtina Beyond
projects.description:
During the municipal elections of October 2025, we collaborated with the Democratic League of Kosova (LDK) and the Mayor of Prishtina, Përparim Rama.

Following the successful 2021 campaign and the victory of Përparim Rama, a win that marked a significant party triumph by returning LDK to power after several years in opposition, the Mayor once again entrusted us with the creative and strategic direction of the campaign. This trust was a direct result of the impact and success achieved during the previous campaign.

Once again, this campaign could not be ordinary. It was built under the slogan …
